question: In a hypothetical sub-critical nuclear reactor, the neutron multiplication factor is $k = 0.99$. An external neutron source is introduced that continuously supplies $N_0 = 1000$ neutrons per generation. What will be the steady-state (equilibrium) number of neutrons present in the reactor per generation after a very long time?
